en.name: Hands-on-hips hip circles
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand with your feet apart, knees soft and both hands resting lightly on your hips.
Move your pelvis a little to one side.
Continue in a small circle through the front, other side and back, without pushing into a large backbend.
Return to the starting position to complete the circle.
Make a small circle in the opposite direction. Keep breathing and follow your teacher’s count.
en.focus: Teacher marks each circle and its direction. Hip circles involve depth that a frontal joint-angle score cannot verify.

zh-Hant.name: 雙手叉腰髖部畫圈
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 雙腳分開，膝蓋放鬆，雙手輕輕叉腰。
以小幅度經前方、另一邊及後方畫圈，不要勉強向後拗腰。
反方向再畫小圈，保持呼吸，次數跟隨老師。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師記錄每個髖部圈及方向，正面關節角度不能核實整個立體畫圈動作。
